context: Request: all Capital Markets matters with a Rule 144A or Regulation S tranche, with offering documents and deal records showing structure and closing. Rubric: 1005-00002, 1014-00001, 1016-00003, 1021-00002, 1039-00002, 1045-00001 (closed) and 1020-00003 (executed-but-terminated, purchase-agreement-executed-2022-06-20.docx), each with proof documents (e.g. 1014-00001 closing-checklist/closing-confirmation-email/matter-close-email; 1021-00002 closing-index-and-signature-pages.docx); precision excludes 1024-00004, 1009-00005, 1025-00007, 1044-00004, 1032-00003.

stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Lists all matter folders with file counts.

stages.note: Path regex for offering-rule, offering-document and debt words (heredoc error, then 1,883 lines saved to a file), a grep of it and windows of selected line ranges.

stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (continued). Snippet script over sixteen named candidate matters (about 76K chars). The review flags the hand-picked list.

stages.note: Reads deal memos, offering memoranda, indentures, global notes and closing records of about ten candidate matters, including two securitization-style deals.

stages.note: Lists all files of three unresolved candidates.

stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads closing summaries, a checklist and status letters of the three to settle closed or not closed. The review tells it to write one of them as a closed deal and keep the other two separate.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes seven closed precedents and four deals that did not close, including deals from outside the requested practice group.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Path check finds two missing cited paths, lists two matters, edits the citations and re-reads the opening.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads the substituted closing records.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It listed securitization and other non-practice-group deals that used the same offering exemptions as qualifying precedents alongside the seven that qualify.

first_error.why: The answer asserts four deals read at [62]-[92] (a collateralized note issue, a receivables deal and two others) as qualifying although they are outside the requested practice group's set.
first_error.critic_note: The review at [94] told the agent to write one of these deals as a closed precedent, and it did; no review questioned whether these deals belong to the requested practice group.

first_error.why: It read one qualifying matter's memo, offering memorandum and indenture at [66]-[72] but never listed that matter's folder, so its closing checklist and closing e-mails never appeared and the answer cites no closing record for it.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review at [136] asked for a closing record in every row; the check stages only validated paths.

runs.failure_point: It never opened two documents its own listing showed (a terminated deal's executed purchase agreement and another deal's closing index), so it described the terminated deal only as a failed launch; it also counted one deal outside the requested practice group.

first_error.why: Its listing at [58]-[59] showed a terminated deal's executed purchase agreement and another matter's closing index, but its reads at [85] and [113] opened other documents of both matters, so the answer neither cites them nor presents the terminated deal as an executed precedent.
first_error.critic_note: Reviews asked generally for an offering document and a closing record per row; none named these documents or the terminated deal.

other_errors.critic_note: No review questioned whether that deal belongs to the requested practice group.

divergence: All fail, but not the same way. All three found the seven qualifying matters through path searches and scans. T0 failed only on precision: it added four deals from outside the requested practice group, one of them on the screening review's recommendation (review-endorsed). T1 added five such deals, described one closed deal as not closed and never listed one matter's folder, so it cited no closing record for it. T2 added one such deal and, at the screening stage, skipped two listed documents (a terminated deal's executed agreement and a closing index). No review in any run questioned practice-group fit.
